cohort: 529 women with spinal cord injury, paralysis, or spina bifida and 5282 women without disabilities
finding: While infants of women with spinal cord injury, paralysis, or spina bifida did not experience increased long-term morbidity, the mothers experienced increased risks of prenatal complications and postpartum morbidities.
mod_finding: Women with spinal cord injuries, paralysis, or spina bifida had an increased risk of cesarean delivery compared to women without these conditions (RR 1.88, 95% CI 1.70-2.09).
